source.title: The Inside-out Growth of the Galactic Disk

population_scope.observational_sample: APOGEE red-clump stars, approximately 6 < R < 13 kpc
population_scope.warning: The fitted tau_m is explicitly described by the authors as the maximum age at which the low-alpha evolution model is trusted, not the age of the entire Milky Way disk.

equations.radially_dependent_SFH: SFH(tau|R0) = c(R0) * exp((((1 - x*R0/8 kpc)*tau) - tau_m)/tau_SFR), normalized from tau=0 to tau=tau_m
equations.radial_migration_kernel: p(R|R0,tau) = N * exp(-(R-R0)^2/(2*sigma(tau)^2)), normalized over physical R>0
equations.historical_half_mass_distribution: At lookback t, integrate stars born at tau>=t and migrate them for elapsed time tau-t before solving M(<R_half,t)=Mtot(t)/2.

stage7_status.role: candidate late-time low-alpha statistical radial source-history operator
stage7_status.use_rule: Validate against the independent Ratcliffe 2026 disc-growth reconstruction before considering any persistence-force test. Do not extrapolate the calibrated low-alpha operator to the old/high-alpha disk without a separately justified early-disc source model.
